# Third-party validation sources

`token-monitor-0.86.0/` contains selected, unmodified files read from the installed Token Monitor 0.86.0 ASAR to validate this local plugin's manifest, package format and UI-loading contract. Individual source paths and hashes are recorded in the adjacent `read-receipt-*.json` files.

Upstream: https://github.com/Javis603/token-monitor/tree/v0.86.0

Copyright (c) 2026 Javis. Distributed under the MIT License, reproduced in `TOKEN-MONITOR-LICENSE.txt`.

The workflow plugin package does not include these vendor validation files.
